title: Debounce
summary: The 'busy flag' pattern: a boolean that blocks re-entry while an action is in progress. The classic fix for Touched firing 20 times per second and remotes being spammed.

verification.source: Community-established pattern; consistent with Roblox event documentation
verification.notes: Pattern entry — educational content, no single API source.

explanation.whatItIs: One boolean gate: 'is this running?' If yes, bail. If no, set it, do the work, clear it.
explanation.whyItExists: Events fire far more often than you want reactions — physics contact happens every frame; multiple parts touch at once. Debounce collapses bursts into single actions.
whenToUse: Button/remote spam protection (paired with server-side checks)
Any handler where re-triggering during execution is wrong
whenNotToUse: When EVERY event matters (input recording) — debounce drops events by design
As your only server-side defense — use real cooldowns + validation there
explanation.mentalModel:
```text
event fires → busy? ─yes→ ignore
                │no
                ▼
            busy = true
            do the thing
            busy = false   (after delay / when done)
```
tips: task.delay/task.wait to hold the gate closed for a cooldown window
Per-object debounce: a table keyed by the target when each actor needs its own gate
The sibling pattern is 'cooldown' — time-based rather than busy-based (see cooldown-pattern)
commonMistakes: Forgetting to clear the flag → permanent lockout
Debouncing only the client while the server stays spammable
Using debounce where you wanted Once (different intent)

examples.title: Damage pad with debounce
examples.code:
local pad = workspace.LavaPad
local busy = false

pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
    if busy then return end
    local humanoid = hit.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then return end

    busy = true
    humanoid:TakeDamage(25)
    task.delay(1, function()
        busy = false          -- reopen the gate after 1s
    end)
end)

examples.title: Per-player debounce table
examples.code:
-- each player gets their own gate
local lastUse = {}
local COOLDOWN = 2

local function tryUse(player)
    local now = os.clock()
    if lastUse[player] and now - lastUse[player] < COOLDOWN then
        return false
    end
    lastUse[player] = now
    return true
end
